summary: Chicago Fire beat Inter Miami 4-1 at Soldier Field on Oct. 4, 2023, with Lionel Messi absent through injury for a fourth straight game. Xherdan Shaqiri and substitute Maren Haile-Selassie each scored twice, lifting Chicago into a playoff position while Inter Miami's postseason hopes were left on life support. The live blog also covers pre-match news about Messi's availability, lineups, injuries and results elsewhere in the Eastern Conference.
one_line: Chicago Fire beat a Messi-less Inter Miami 4-1 at Soldier Field, with braces from Shaqiri and Haile-Selassie, boosting their playoff hopes.
key_facts: Chicago Fire beat Inter Miami 4-1 on Wednesday, Oct. 4, 2023, at Soldier Field, with braces from Xherdan Shaqiri (50', 73') and Maren Haile-Selassie (62', 66').
Inter Miami's only goal was a Josef Martinez penalty in the 53rd minute, after a handball by Chicago's Jonathan Dean; Chicago had led for just three minutes.
Lionel Messi missed his fourth straight Inter Miami game through injury, and Inter Miami are winless in four games without him.
Inter Miami must win their final three games and get outside help to make the playoffs.
The win moved Chicago into a playoff position in the Eastern Conference standings; they had entered 11th.
A record Chicago Fire crowd of 62,124 attended at Soldier Field.
Haile-Selassie came on in the 55th minute for Brian Gutierrez, who was reportedly pulled with a sore knee.
Gerardo Martino received a yellow card before the second half for Inter Miami returning late to the pitch.
Inter Miami missed good chances at 58' (Facundo Farias) and 59' (Benja Cremaschi) before Chicago took the lead.
Elsewhere, the New York Red Bulls beat Eastern Conference leaders FC Cincinnati 2-1, CF Montreal equalized late against the Houston Dynamo, and Charlotte FC beat Toronto FC 3-0.
Kei Kamara, with 144 MLS goals, was one behind Landon Donovan on the all-time list; Chris Wondolowski leads with 171.
Shaqiri said he would choose Messi over Ronaldo, citing Messi's World Cup win.
Inter Miami were without Jordi Alba and Leonardo Campana (muscle injuries); Tomas Aviles was suspended.
The match streamed on Apple TV+ (MLS Season Pass) at 8:30 p.m. ET.
